She couldn't stay with the leader on much slower ground when third in Cork, however, that form looks decent after the winner finished in a dead-heat for third in Listed class at Royal Ascot. There is highly likely to be more to come from Aidan O'Brien's Naas winner First Approach who gets first-time cheekpieces after running unplaced in his last couple of starts in better company, while Fresh Fade has put three solid runs together and is a major contender.

selections.comment: THERIVERRUNSDEEP could do damage off a mark of 46 with Terry Casey's 7lb claim factored in. She knows where the winning post is having clocked up six victories throughout her career. The Camacho mare was last seen finishing third at Dundalk in September and Sam Coen is a good booking for her. If Eclairage runs well in the 5.40 race on this card, it would boost the prospects of Skillman Ave who came home third behind her on two occasions at Dundalk last year. She wasn't beaten far into fifth in a first-time visor at Listowel last month. Top-weight This Ain't Texas is a lightly-raced sort with more upside than most.

Justify filly Just Before has shown more than enough to be in the mix for a cheque despite shouldering top-weight as she has form in better class races. Mother Mara looks threatening on the back of being pipped by a short head in Fairyhouse at the end of May, while Beautiful Affair has slipped down to a mark of 70 which she should be competitive off.

He didn't get a clear run that day, albeit well beaten but his latest effort is decent enough form in behind some promising rivals who have franked the form since. Shams is an interesting newcomer from Blue Point.

selections.comment: RESERVARDO has been ultra-consistent in his opening seven starts, despite winning just once has been placed in every other start and has been well fancied throughout. This looks another good opportunity for the Crisford yard, he was headed late at Redcar last time and will hope to go one better here. Kinetic Force was well backed last time when not getting a clear run in behind a runaway winner but did win at Bath in April and should have scope to improve off a mark of 86. Master Of My Fate arrives in good form off the back of a game win at Lingfield and a third place at Ayr, he's won four times already this term and remains in good form.

Jax Edge goes well here and another who enjoys the quicker ground conditions, she went close here again last time after a 6 month break, showing she is still in form (having completed a double when last seen in December). Cheif Mankato travelled well but headed close home at Windsor last time, he had placed twice in his last three starts prior to that so ought to be in the shake up again.

selections.comment: This is a good opportunity for FOREST CAPER to open his account on third of time of asking after two promising runs to date. David O'Meara's gelding will need to be less free than last time when just failing to make all at Beverley last time as he could find no extra once headed but held on for second. The step back up to 1m is a positive if he can settle a bit better and he looks the one to beat. Gentle Touch is a big threat having shown much more last time stepped up to 7f and can take another step in the right direction upped to 1m but Wolfpack is feared more. James Ferguson's colt made a very promising debut last November when second at Southwell over a mile but flopped on this season's opener dropped back to 7f. He was outpaced (and possibly drawn on the wrong side) then and the return to a mile should help. he can prove that effort to be wrong and give the selction most do. Saxon Lover is an interesting newcomer and could get involved and needs checking for strong market moves

selections.comment: An extremely tight contest with a number of last time out winners. Intosomethinggood did well to win here on his debut but the form of that is nothing special and he will need to progress again to defy a penalty. Currumbin's greater turn of foot was decisive here on his hurdle debut where he built a useful yardstick so he is respected along with fellow dual purpose performer Knights Affair. That rival arguably travelled best on his follow up attempt before being outstayed late by one who has won again since. Back down in distance he may do best of those with previous hurdle wins. They could all be vulnerable however to NANA NOODLEMAN who gets plenty of weight from all of her rivals and was a bumper winner here when last seen. She represents a top jockey/trainer combination and could get off the mark over hurdles at the first time of asking.
